newsitem.title: JAPAN: Capcom jumps on strong earnings results.
newsitem.headline: Capcom jumps on strong earnings results.

text.p: Shares of Capcom Co Ltd, a leading producer of home computer game software, jumped on Tuesday, helped by strong earnings results announced late on Monday, traders said.
At 0505 GMT, the shares were 180 yen higher at 2,480 on the Osaka Securities Exchange. They briefly rose to 2,540, a high for this calendar year. Turnover was 61,000 shares.
On Monday, Capcom said it posted group net profits of 502 million yen for the year to March 31, 1997, recovering from group net losses of 2.70 billion yen a year earlier.
The company expects its group net profits to increase to 3.70 billion yen in 1997/98.
